F-P0-003_D4_4A_relationship.session: Sprint 1 retrospective review 工艺工程师 2026-10-01
F-P0-003_D4_4A_relationship.ruling: F-P0-003 是 D4 裁决 4A 未落地的证据 — D4 4A 的 'state_machine 拥有 CHANGED 流程触发权' 不仅适用 Sprint 4, 需回修 Sprint 1 的 sync_from_source.
F-P0-003_D4_4A_relationship.fix_pattern: sync_from_source 不应直接 ORM UPDATE EquipmentList.sign_status; 应调 state_machine.transition(record=existing, to_status=source.sign_status, actor=system_actor, reason='sync_from_source'). 这样写 audit_logs + 走 TRANSITION_ROLES ACL.
F-P0-003_D4_4A_relationship.scope_extension: D4 4A 落地范围扩展回 Sprint 1.

F-P0-004_BLOCKER_3_registration.session: Sprint 1 retrospective review 工艺工程师 2026-10-01

F-P0-005_alembic_transaction_complexity.session: Sprint 1 retrospective review 工艺工程师 2026-10-01
F-P0-005_alembic_transaction_complexity.ruling: 原报告说 '加 postgresql_concurrently=True' 不完整. CONCURRENTLY 在 alembic transaction 内不能跑 — 需 op.execute('COMMIT') 或在 migration 里禁 transaction.
F-P0-005_alembic_transaction_complexity.fix_pattern:
def upgrade(): op.execute('COMMIT')  # 结束 alembic 事务
op.create_index('ix_audit_logs_detail_json_gin', 'audit_logs', ['detail_json'], postgresql_using='gin', postgresql_concurrently=True, if_not_exists=True).
F-P0-005_alembic_transaction_complexity.complexity_correction: 修复复杂度被原报告低估.

F-P1-005_sprint1_F-P0-004_same_root.ruling: F-P1-005 (Sprint 2 review) 与 F-P0-004 (Sprint 1 review) 同源 — 都是 pre-existing cross-project IDOR. 应合并登记为 BLOCKER-3.
F-P1-005_sprint1_F-P0-004_same_root.rationale: F-P0-003 (audit bypass) 是 F-P0-004 (IDOR) 的放大器. 修复顺序: 先 F-P0-003 恢复 audit trail; F-P0-004 可延后 (登记 BLOCKER-3). 因为有了 audit trail, 即使 IDOR 存在, 也能被审计发现.

F-P1-009_G08_baseline_drift_R1.ruling: G-08 baseline 与 endpoint 代码同批 = silent drift risk. 登记为 R=1 变体; P7-3 process workflow (前端 snapshot-mtime CI gate) 跟进.

primary_findings.title: PSYCHRO type_code 'X' collides with 'Motor/Electrical' — psychrometric CHECKED mis-classified as electrical
GET /util/summary 'latest' returns random UtilResult (UUIDv4 util_result_id order, not created_at)
State machine audit bypass — sync_from_source mutates EquipmentList.sign_status directly (no AuditLog writes; D4 4A 未落地证据)
primary_findings.process_engineering_correction: F-P0-003 是 D4 4A 未落地的证据. 修复 = 调 state_machine.transition(record, to_status, actor, reason) 而非直接 ORM UPDATE. D4 4A 落地范围扩展回 Sprint 1.
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Replace direct `existing.sign_status = source.sign_status` with `state_machine.transition(record=existing, to_status=source.sign_status, actor=system_actor, reason='sync_from_source')` — write AuditLog + TRANSITION_ROLES.

primary_findings.title: Pre-existing cross-project IDOR — every endpoint trusts client project_id (BLOCKER-3, P7-7+ UserProject model)
primary_findings.process_engineering_correction: 登记为 BLOCKER-3. 与 Sprint 2 review F-P1-005 同源. 不阻塞 Sprint 1 hotfix 批; F-P0-003 (audit bypass) 修复后, IDOR 越权可被追溯.
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Add UserProject/WorkspaceMember model + per-project ACL check (P7-7+ scope).

primary_findings.title: audit_logs GIN index built WITHOUT CONCURRENTLY — alembic transaction complexity underestimated
primary_findings.process_engineering_correction: postgresql_concurrently=True 不能在 alembic transaction 内跑. 需 op.execute('COMMIT') 结束 alembic 事务 或 在 migration 里禁 transaction.
primary_findings.suggested_fix:
def upgrade(): op.execute('COMMIT')  # 结束 alembic 事务
op.create_index('ix_audit_logs_detail_json_gin', 'audit_logs', ['detail_json'], postgresql_using='gin', postgresql_concurrently=True, if_not_exists=True).
